about: Music palette for reels; the sound brief is docs/content-engine/sound.md. A reel names one entry (spec.music). Sampler entries are played by real recorded instruments (VCSL, CC0) in music.py and regenerated by render.mjs at the reel's exact length; file entries point to a track Asaf supplied, with its licence. Only entries with approved: true can be published; approving a track is Asaf's call, by ear.

lounge-f.use: Default. Development, money, decisions, the founder's view: a smooth, confident groove (piano, vibraphone, round bass, light swung drums).

airy-d.use: AI, systems, processes: the lightest bed, no kick or snare; clean and precise.

night-a.use: Stuck properties, families, risk: minor colours, unhurried, respectful.
